decisions.rationale: Action action-002 names Timure only in a broad GRA-product review, while action-003 requests activation-wide reports. Neither creates an immediate, Timure-specific human access-verification priority before dependent field actions.

Action action-002 names Bidur but requests general damage and density overlays within 24 hours. It does not perform an immediate, Bidur-specific residential response-needs triage using damage evidence.
Action action-002 names Syapru Besi but requests general product review. No action requests a critical-services continuity check near Syapru Besi within six hours.

The action cites the CEMS snapshot, keeps Bharatpur's waiting GRA product visible, and requests delivery details without asserting no impact. Its six-hour review timing is more conservative than the monitor window.
